libCompetencies.title: Competencies
libCompetencies.sub: Your organisation's competency definitions, anchors and observation tags. Hiring, and later other tools, read them from here.
libCompetencies.emptyTitle: The library is not set up yet
libCompetencies.emptyBody: Add Kademe's 8 starter competencies with their anchors and observation tags. You then edit all of them with your team.
libCompetencies.seeded: Kademe starter content, not reviewed by your team
libCompetencies.archivedNote: Archived. It cannot be picked for new questions; past assessments stay readable.
libCompetencies.name: Name
libCompetencies.descriptionHint: For the team. Never shown to a candidate.
libCompetencies.anchorsSub: Write an observable behaviour for each level. 1, 3 and 5 are required; 2 and 4 are optional.
libCompetencies.hintAdjective: This reads as a trait, not a behaviour. Write something a reviewer can observe: "summarises the other person's question in their own words".
libCompetencies.hintShort: This definition is very short. Say in one sentence what the reviewer will see in the answer.
libCompetencies.tagsSub: Evidence a reviewer marks with one click. At most 6 on each side.
libCompetencies.tagLimit: At most {max} tags on this side.
libCompetencies.liveNote: This change applies to new versions. {count, plural, one {# live assessment keeps} other {# live assessments keep}} the previous definition.
libCompetencies.archivedNoSave: An archived competency cannot be changed. Restore it first.
libCompetencies.noPermission: Your role cannot change the library.
libCompetencies.archiveHint: An archived competency cannot be picked for new questions; assessments that use it do not change.
libCompetencies.newSub: Name and definition first. You write anchors and tags on the next screen.

libScales.sub: General level names. Each competency's anchors fill in this frame.
libScales.noEvidence: No evidence: left out of the average, not the same as 1.
libScales.readOnly: Only an owner can rename the levels.

libPositions.title: Positions
libPositions.sub: What a role requires: definition, job ad and competency profile.
libPositions.emptyBody: A position keeps what a role requires in one place. Hiring, and later other tools, read it from here.
libPositions.archivedNote: Archived. It cannot be picked for new openings.
libPositions.name: Name
libPositions.jobDescriptionHint: The AI draft reads this text. 120 characters are enough; longer is better.
libPositions.profileSub: The competencies the role requires and how much each matters. An opening scales the weights to 100%.
libPositions.noMoreCompetencies: Every competency in the library is in the profile.
libPositions.profileEmpty: No competencies yet. An opening's scorecard then starts with equal weights.
libPositions.weightInvalid: Importance must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
libPositions.noPermission: Your role cannot change the library.
libPositions.usageEmpty: Not used in any opening yet.
libPositions.newSub: A name is enough. Add the job ad and the AI draft proposes questions from it.
libPositions.archivedNoSave: An archived position cannot be changed. Restore it first.
libPositions.competencyRefused: A competency in the profile can no longer be picked. Reload the page and try again.
libPositions.profileLimit: A profile holds at most {max} competencies.
libPositions.listInvalid: Up to {skills} skills ({skillMax} characters each) and {languages} languages ({languageMax} characters each).
